known_methodological_limitations: Development overfitting: 27/30 DOCX inputs built by internal scripts/build_docx.py & generate_docx.py; prompts reference specific parameter targets.

Oracle and grader coupling: evals/run_layout_benchmark.py imports scripts/* (map_docx, diff_layout, ooxml_order, layout_edit, auto_paginate, validate_docx) to execute golden plans and grade submissions.
Synthetic distribution bias: clean OOXML without multi-tier Word/GDocs/WPS quirks, tblW=pct/auto inheritance, or >150 KB real-world documents.
Sequential SKILL.md evolution: Batch 1 (T01-T12) ran on SKILL.md 7,013 B, Batch 2 (T13-T18) on 8,827 B, and SKILL.md was edited post-hoc after observing T13/T17 token usage (9,484 B at freeze).
Accuracy ceiling saturation: both without_skill and with_skill achieved 25/25 (100%) hit rate on T01-T18, yielding Normalized Gain g = 0.0% and measuring efficiency rather than correctness lift.
disallowed_claims: independent accuracy superiority over unguided agents
